title: Baked Hawaiian Sandwiches
description: Cheesy ham and turkey sliders on Hawaiian rolls, topped with a honey-mustard sauce, then baked until golden brown. Sure to be a hit!
ingredients: 24 Hawaiian bread rolls (such as King's®), split
12 thin slices of honey-cured deli ham, halved
12 thin slices deli smoked turkey, halved

steps.text: Place a rack into lower half of the oven and preheat the oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C).

Arrange bottom halves of Hawaiian rolls on a baking sheet. Place a half slice each of ham, Swiss cheese, smoked turkey, and provolone cheese onto each roll bottom. Place top halves onto each bottom to make sandwiches.

Melt butter in a saucepan over low heat; stir in sugar, dried onion flakes, poppy seeds, and honey mustard until mixture is smooth and sugar has dissolved, about 2 minutes; brush over the tops of each sandwich.
Bake sandwiches on the preheated oven's lower rack until tops are golden brown and fillings are hot, about 15 minutes.

video.description: Need to feed a crowd? These delectable and easy-to make sandwiches will be gone in no time! And when they’re this easy to prepare, you’ll make them again and again. First begin with a large package of Hawaiian bread rolls. Place the bottom layer of rolls on a baking sheet then top with honey-cured ham, Swiss cheese, smoked turkey, provolone cheese and the tops of the rolls. Next, create the essential sauce to take these sandwiches into mind-blowingly delicious territory: melt butter with sugar, onion flakes, poppy seeds and honey mustard. Brush on the sandwich tops and bake! Great for tailgating parties, potlucks, receptions or winning over picky eaters.
